title: [Lean] Prove owner matching, compaction and full-row checker soundness
body:
This contribution proves whole-owner width matching and offset compaction in Lean 4.21.0. From sorted componentwise width domination, an executable merge-sort/first-fit allocator succeeds, assigns a fitting owner to every helper, and preserves every owner identity. A threshold-count exchange lemma proves that any fitting choice for a largest remaining demand preserves feasibility; a separate theorem covers stateful selection policies with explicit local soundness and availability contracts. Prefix-sum compaction preserves capacity and gives nonaliasing addresses with gap-free occupied-prefix coverage.

The package includes source-bound packing tables for:
- PR527 at `2080903b9e6bd01e3f64cc4c7c62ea1b3af0aa6a`: 29 templates, 40,320 roles, 15,898 groups, 72 calls.
- The selected PR531 package imported in main at `db0e57bc7f36b5ac0fc844ad7ce1396165ee6647`: five templates, 36,288 roles, 15,302 groups, 72 calls.

A general full-row owner-table checker now has proved soundness: accepted rows have a complete call/helper census, checked inverse group/family links, declared-window membership and capacity, nonaliasing offsets within each owner group, and unique physical-family identifiers within each call. Its block checker proves occupied-prefix coverage. The complete PR531 row witness is not yet certified; generic checker soundness does not discharge that remaining finite computation.

Validation: fresh local compilation of all six modules passed. All 61 theorem axiom reports contain only standard Lean axioms or none. There are no proof placeholders, custom axioms, or native evaluation proof shortcuts. Exact source regeneration, six matching regression examples, one accepted owner-table fixture and nine Lean rejection controls, twelve corrupted-source controls, and rejection of a false Lean capacity claim passed. Receipts and complete axiom reports are retained. The isolated CI runs the same verifier; its remote status is separate from the local receipt.

Scope: Lean proves the generic matching/compaction arguments, both finite template tables, and full-row checker soundness. Python still parses JSON and associates actual source records with those tables. The source Python allocator, its old-to-new assignment relation, and its physical semantics are not yet proved. The general stateful-policy theorem states its policy contract explicitly and claims no selector runtime bound. No new kappa or full multiplication theorem is claimed.

`FULL-PROOF-STATUS.md` preserves the full target: the selected PR531/PR493 bound with kappa `1517760977820331/10^18`, on one deterministic fixed finite-tape machine, exact padded products for every input length and the stated worst-case asymptotic runtime. The source decoder, complete physical word/schedule, uniform compiler, numerical recovery, prime supply and analytic transfer remain open obligations. These are not replaced by unproved project axioms or hidden behind certificate success.

This complements incorporated #509/#516 and #528/#530/#540. PR527's predecessors include Dugongue #522 and icekylinx #523; imported PR531 excerpts retain icekylinx's authorship and GPT-6 Astra disclosure. New proofs/verifier: Rohan Arun with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. No independent human audit or priority claim for the underlying elementary matching argument.

Reproduce from `research/lean-owner-transport` with a new output directory:
```sh
python3 -B verify.py --lean /path/to/lean-4.21.0 --build-dir /absolute/new/output
```
